contextCompiler.purpose: Compile minimum sufficient, evidence-linked context for one task without replacing HEAD authority.
contextCompiler.authority: Materialized context is derived and rebuildable; canonical sources and user-owned decisions remain authoritative.
contextCompiler.failurePolicy: Fail closed on canon drift; harness adapters may fail open to normal agent operation when compilation is unavailable.

executionLineage.purpose: Connect whole-plan authority, bounded execution, evidence-linked results, and HEAD review without relying on provider conversation state.
executionLineage.identity: Artifacts use content-derived identifiers, digest verification, and typed parent relationships.
executionLineage.status: Contract-bound Runs, evidence-linked Result Packets, deterministic Fresh HEAD review projections, ReviewDecision-linked plan generations, and authority-free knowledge proposals are active; provider runtime hydration and authorized promotion are deferred.

worldModel.purpose: Materialize rebuildable repository file, symbol, dependency, import, and call evidence for task-specific compilation.
worldModel.store: replaceable-rebuildable-materialized-view via a versioned WorldModelStoreAdapter; local-json is the active adapter
worldModel.authority: Derived evidence only; project canon and user-owned decisions remain authoritative.
worldModel.coverage: Supported text files, heuristic symbols/dependencies, evidence-linked file/symbol/import/call graph, all reachable Git commit-message decision evidence, current Git refs, canonical HEAD lifecycle state, point-in-time host-exported external runtime observations, and bounded semantic/history/runtime traversal are active; AST-accurate analysis, structured Git decision inference, live runtime probing/control, and the optional GraphDB adapter are deferred.

roles.head: Owns whole-outcome understanding, strategy, integration, and completion judgment.
roles.developer: Owns one bounded, independently consumable implementation result.
roles.coder: Implements a fully decided Run contract without changing observable behavior.
roles.reviewer: Evaluates consequential decisions before implementation without choosing the final direction.

invariants: The user retains material product, policy, architecture, cost, workflow, and external-action authority.
Canonical project state outranks conversation summaries and transient logs.
A project identifier maps to one canonical project root.
Managed files are never overwritten after user modification.
Runtime-specific sessions remain distinct from HEAD session and Run identifiers.
activeCapabilities: authority-free knowledge proposals and HEAD recommendations
heuristic evidence-linked semantic call graph and bounded traversal
versioned GitHistoryAdapter and all-reachable commit-message decision evidence
versioned RuntimeStateAdapter and host-exported point-in-time runtime evidence
deferredCapabilities: automatic provider runtime hydration from Fresh HEAD review
authorized knowledge promotion into project canon
structured Git decision inference and supersession
